{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}


::: {#exr-puppy-iron-bolt}
The mixed partials are equal. Demonstrate this by looking at the derivatives of the function $g(x, t) \equiv a x + b t + c x t$. The mixed partial corresponds to the interaction terms. The interaction of x with t is the same as the interaction of t with x. YOU CAN ALSO GO ON TO THE GENERIC QUADRATIC FORM. Show that the derivatives of this are LINEAR FUNCTIONS and, in the second generation, CONSTANT FUNCTIONS.
:::
 <!-- end of exr-puppy-iron-bolt -->
